The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 1991, «Сильван Газский, пресвитер, сщмч.», with the office and the rank word left off. The day line gives «Сильвана, пресвитера Газского».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Сильвана, пресвитера Газского (IV).»
source.note: No rank is read onto this line. The day prints two icons and both stand in its first paragraph: the plain service, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service the Typikon marks with no sign at all, before the four martyrs of Milan, and «Совершается служба со славословием» immediately before Paraskeva-Petka, which is that one great line's alone. Neither reaches a later line.

attestations.note: The Russian gives this folder its first date, the fourth century, and the three things no other calendar prints for him: that he was of Gaza and was its presbyter, that he was sent to forced labour in the mines of the Palestinian town of Phaeno for his zeal in spreading the faith, and that he was beheaded in the end together with forty Christian soldiers. The calendar calls him «сщмч.», a hieromartyr, and «пресвитер», which is the priesthood and not the bishopric this folder's types carry from the Greek.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same menologion day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same man: of Gaza in Palestine, gentle and harmless and old, a soldier before, made a presbyter for the purity of his life, beaten by the crowd at Caesarea, sent to the mines at Zoora and beheaded in old age and sickness. **A difference worth naming, and not a contradiction of the row**: the folder carries `types: ["martyr", "bishop"]` on doxologia's word that he was counted worthy to be made a bishop after the faithful got him away from the mines, and this page gives him no bishopric — it says «έγινε Πρεσβύτερος στην Εκκλησία της Γάζας», and at the mines «με παρότρηση του λαού, γίνεται επίτροπος», a steward. It adds that he had been a soldier. Nothing is changed on the strength of it; the paragraph says what this page says. The page gives no year, only «επί Διοκλητιανού (284 - 304 μ.Χ.)», so no `dates` object, and it prints no hymn. Its last sentence is the ground of the new folder `forty-martyrs-of-egypt-and-palestine` in batch `el-10-14`. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

death.note: The century days.pravoslavie.ru prints after his name, «Сщмч. Сильвана, пресвитера Газского (IV)», and repeats in its life. Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gives a date, and this folder held none.
